issue.title: [202012][warm-reboot] Orchagent crash during warm-reboot from 201811 to 202012 at processQuadInInitViewModeRemove

failure.body:
#### Description

Orchagent crash during warm-reboot from 201811 to 202012 image which includes changes to add back 10G ports (https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/pull/9820).

Syslog error:
```
str-s6100-acs-2 ERR syncd#syncd: :- processQuadInInitViewModeRemove: port object (oid:0x1000000000022) can't be removed in init view mode
str-s6100-acs-2 ERR syncd#syncd: :- run: Runtime error: :- processQuadInInitViewModeRemove: port object (oid:0x1000000000022) can't be removed in init view mode
```
Sairedis:
```
|s|SAI_OBJECT_TYPE_SWITCH:oid:0x21000000000000|SAI_SWITCH_ATTR_LAG_DEFAULT_HASH_SEED=0
|r|SAI_OBJECT_TYPE_PORT:oid:0x1000000000022
|n|switch_shutdown_request|{"switch_id":"oid:0x21000000000000"}|
```

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. Load 201811 image
2. Warm-reboot to 202012 image which includes https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/pull/9820

#### Describe the results you received:
Orchagent crash with the above error logged by syncd in syslog

#### Describe the results you expected:
Warm-reboot completes with no crash

resolution.title: [warmboot] Migrate 10G ports during warm-reboot on s6100
resolution.description:
#### What I did
Changes include db-migration logic to add back 10G ports on 6100 during warm-reboot from earlier image to ensure config and app DB are in sync with new port_config.ini

#### How I did it
Set configdb manually and update corresponding new entries in appdb

#### How to verify it
This PR fixes https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/issues/9976
